title: FBI and USDA Reportedly Target of Cyberattacks
excerpt: Reports indicate both the FBI and the USDA experienced cyberattacks, with the FBI's National Crime Information Center targeted.
body_html:
Both the US Department of Agriculture (USDA) and the FBI were reportedly targeted in cyberattacks.

According to reports, the incident involving the FBI marks the second attack on the agency within a recent span of a few months. This particular breach targeted the National Crime Information Center, a system utilized by federal, state, and local law enforcement.
